description: This file defines the PrivilegeEditor class, a Java class that extends PropertyEditorSupport to handle the conversion between Privilege objects and their string representations. It facilitates serialization/deserialization of Privilege instances for form processing within the OpenMRS platform, supporting lookup by privilege name or UUID.

classes.name: PrivilegeEditor
classes.description: A property editor for Privilege objects, enabling conversion between Privilege instances and their string identifiers for form handling and data serialization.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a string (name or UUID) into a Privilege object and sets it as the value.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Privilege object, typically its privilege name.
